test_title: PYST 14: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split Into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The sky appears blue as / it absorbs all colours / and reflects only blue / No error.
solution:
The correct answer is **"No error"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"The sky appears blue as"** – This clause essentially states that the sky looks blue because of a reason that's about to follow.
